records.name: Meister Rückstau
records.biography_en: Has heard every pipe excuse and trusts the dripping one least. His wrench tightens HyperNorm rules until they stop leaking exceptions. A dissonant card points out that the pressure is still somewhere inside. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Nachgezogen wurde alles außer der Erklärung.

variant_notes.note_en: Has heard every pipe excuse and trusts the dripping one least.

records.name: Lecksucher Tropfgenau
records.biography_en: Can hear a leak rehearsing before it makes its first appearance. He listens through the HyperNorm pipes for unauthorized ambiguity. A dissonant card makes a tiny noise exactly where the plans promise silence. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Leck befindet sich kurz vor seiner Entdeckung.

variant_notes.note_en: Can hear a leak rehearsing before it makes its first appearance.

records.name: Abflussmeisterin Freilauf
records.biography_en: Enjoys finding the one blockage everybody else has learned to live with. She clears HyperNorm drains of everything filed as other people's problem. A dissonant card returns with a remarkably useful question caught in the coil. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Widerstand war offenbar nicht systembedingt.

variant_notes.note_en: Enjoys finding the one blockage everybody else has learned to live with.

records.name: Azubine Dichtungsfrage
records.biography_en: Suspects that the missing piece is asking the wrong question. Her washer belongs to a HyperNorm fitting nobody can identify. A dissonant card suggests that not fitting might be valuable information. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Ersatzteil wartet auf seinen ursprünglichen Zweck.

variant_notes.note_en: Suspects that the missing piece is asking the wrong question.

records.name: Heizungswart Warmgenug
records.biography_en: Keeps the building warm through arguments that could heat it unaided. He turns HyperNorm warmth either on or off, as instructed. A dissonant card asks for comfortable and ruins the simplicity of the valve. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Temperatur ist geregelt. Das Wohlbefinden nicht.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps the building warm through arguments that could heat it unaided.

records.name: Rohrschmied Bogenmaß
records.biography_en: Can persuade a straight line to consider other arrangements. His copper bends accommodate HyperNorm corners marked impossible. A dissonant card recommends showing the same flexibility toward residents. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Gerade hat einer gütlichen Biegung zugestimmt.

variant_notes.note_en: Can persuade a straight line to consider other arrangements.
